## Necrophage Leaper, Horrid Mutant Horse (Augmented Advanced Heavy Horse) (CR 4)

**XP** 1,200  
NE Large aberration  
**Init** +4; **Senses** darkvision 60 Perception +1  


**Defense**


**AC** 21, touch 15, flat-footed 15 (+6 Dex, -1 size, +6 natural)  
**hp** 42 (3d8+18)  
**Fort** +7, Ref +7, Will +6  
**Defensive Abilities** DR 5/-, from the void  
**Immune** cold, disease, mind-affecting effects, poison  
**Weaknesses** limb weakness  


**Offense**


**Speed** 50 ft., Climb 30 ft.  
**Melee** bite +10 (1d4+7), stinger +11 (1d8+10)  
**Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 5 ft.  


**Statistics**


**Str** 24, **Dex** 22, **Con** 23, **Int** -, **Wis** 17, **Cha** 6  
**Base Attack** +3; **CMB** +10; **CMD** 26 (30 vs. trip)  
**Feats** Weapon Focus (stinger)  
**Skills** Stealth +12; **Racial Modifiers** +8 Stealth  


**Ecology**


**Environment** Any, dark tapestry  
**Organization** solitary, pair or with necrophage carrier  
**Treasure** none  


**Special Abilities**


**Limb Weakness (Ex)** If the necrophage is subject to a critical hit, it loses a limb, the limb lost can be randomly determined or chosen by the GM. If it loses a leg, it could cause the creature to become prone or if an attacking limb is severed, it loses a natural attack.
